The Job:

Based in North America, you will stand this vertical up from strategy through execution: defining where we play and how we win across hyperscale, colocation and enterprise data center customers, and across the EPC, OEM and equipment manufacturers who serve them.  Fastening-specific automation sits at the center of this role. Data center construction and equipment assembly are constrained by skilled labor availability and cycle time, and our automated installation and assembly technology is the sharpest edge we have. You will make the core of the vertical value proposition — and be equally credible discussing it in a customer’s engineering review and defending a three-year margin plan in a business review.

Vertical Strategy & Growth Framework
- Own the global Data Center vertical strategy — market sizing, segmentation, prioritization and a multi-year roadmap with clear where-to-play and how-to-win choices across all three regions.
- Develop and execute the annual strategic business plan for revenue, gross margin and share gain, with regional plans that roll up to a single global number.
- Continuously analyze target markets — hyperscale’s, colocation providers, EPC and MEP contractors, rack and enclosure OEMs, power distribution, busway and liquid cooling manufacturers — and define market-specific value propositions grounded in customer need.
- Convert industry signals — AI-driven capacity growth, liquid cooling adoption, modular and prefabricated construction, regional buildout cycles, supply chain shifts — into commercial action.

Fastening Application & Automation Leadership
- Serve as the global authority on engineered fastening applications in data center environments — rack and enclosure assembly, cable management and power distribution, cooling infrastructure, and vibration-sensitive joints.
- Identify technology gaps and innovation opportunities specific to the vertical
- Act as the conduct between the field and product development, translating application insight into the future-state solution and innovation pipeline.

Go-to-Market & Demand Generation
- Lead demand generation strategy and go-to-market execution, ensuring segmentation-based priorities are consistently deployed across regions.
- Define the global account targeting strategy; partner with regional sales leadership on account plans, specification strategy and named hyperscale and colocation pursuits.
- ·Direct vertical content, technical collateral, application case studies and campaign development in partnership with marketing.

Commercial Ownership
- Own the commercial health of the vertical — pipeline, revenue, gross margin, and funnel conversion — and drive corrective action where gaps emerge.
- Build the metrics, dashboards and reporting cadence that measure vertical success and inform resource allocation.

Global Stakeholder Management
- Align and influence a matrixed global network — regional sales leaders, product management, engineering, operations, marketing and finance across three regions — largely without direct authority.
- Lead and develop vertical resources, including direct and dotted-line team members across regions.
- Navigate regional differences in customer structure, buying behavior, construction practice and standards — adapting the global framework without fragmenting it.

- Minimum 8-10 years in marketing, sales, product management or business development within industrial, engineered products or construction-adjacent markets.
- Deep, demonstrable data center market knowledge — the customers, buying cycle, delivery model and technical requirements. Prior experience serving hyperscale, colocation or data center construction ecosystems is preferred.
- Direct experience with engineered fastening applications and with fastening-specific or assembly automation.
- Track record of building a growth strategy from market analysis through to an executed commercial plan, owning revenue and margin outcomes.

The Job:
As a Quality and Continuous Improvement Engineer, you’ll be part of our team working as an onsite employee.  The Quality And Continuous Improvement Engineer, in accordance with Product Group policies, provides for the effective control of quality as required for the Plant’s operations through determination and regulation of product conformance, and the evaluation and improvement, where necessary, of manufacturing and supplier quality performance. You’ll get to:
- Provides and maintains measures of the Plant's quality performance in terms of quality costs, customer returns and complaints, product conformance, and manufacturing and supplier performance. Establishes quality performance goals.  Reports and takes action when goals are exceeded.
- Defines the system, policy, and procedures for the control of quality in and for the Plant and regularly determines adherence to these by all functions. Makes changes as required to improve effectiveness.
- Conducts audits of the Plant Quality Assurance system, including adequacy of records, effectiveness of procedures and performance of personnel.
- Provides for the development of product quality and reliability, and the definition of product quality characteristics, control points, inspection for conformance, means of determination, records and feedback for purchased and manufactured materials, parts and products.
- Provides for the evaluation and control of product and process quality through: inspection for conformance to requirements of purchased material and parts, work-in-process, finished goods, packaging and labeling; controls disposition and costs on nonconforming material; identifying corrective action needs; assurance of gages, measuring and test equipment accuracy.
- Recommends department organization, expense and capital, long-range plans and budget needs, and operates the department within approved budget
- Support ISO 9001 certification program - Participate with internal ISO audits to monitor compliance.
- Assist with recertification during Registrar visits.
- Develop and maintain work instructions per ISO requirements.

- Assist with Supplier Performance Reviews - Document floor complaints.
- Issue NCMRs and CARs as needed.
- Follow up with correctives actions to insure compliance.
- Audit key vendors as necessary.

- Research new processes as directed.

- Facilitates kaizen events and other lean initiatives such as 5’s, one-piece flow, standardized work, Kanban
- Performs workplace audits and streaming processes within area of responsibility.
- Utilizes knowledge of value stream analysis; project management; data collection and analysis; and development and implementation of process improvements to drive change.
- Creates work instructions, reports, and presentations using accurate data to drive continuous improvement.

The Person:
You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have:
- Bachelor's degree in Quality, Engineering or related technical field
- 5+ years of related Quality leadership experience
- 3+ years of related Continuous Improvement experience
- Certified Quality Engineer (ASQ) or equivalent
- Lean / Six Sigma certification is a plus
- PC knowledge/computer literate
- Familiarity with manufacturing environment
- Knowledge of quality function, lean manufacturing (TPS), ISO requirements
- Independent worker (must be able to assign and complete assignments independently)
- Good interpersonal skills
- Good organizational skills
- Excellent verbal/written communication skills
- Familiarity with inspection procedures
- Understanding and support of Company policies and procedures

The Details:
You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan, including:
- Medical, dental, life, vision, disability, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being.
- Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs.

And More:

- Grow: Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.

- Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal.
- Belong: Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for a wide range of perspectives and experiences.
- Give Back: Help us continue to make positive changes locally and globally through volunteerism, giving back, and sustainable business practices.

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company.
